order: Deflated Sharpe on the certificate (higher first; no value ranks last)
score.note: Return, profit and Sharpe are not part of the score. The Deflated Sharpe only breaks ties between equal ARL and depth, and it already pays for the n_trials recorded in the certificate.

A.name: open
A.meaning: The code is public, so anyone can run `monte-neo verify --recheck` and reproduce the certificate. The submitter reproduced it locally and the maintainer reproduces it again before the entry is merged.

B.name: privately verified
B.meaning: The author passed the code to the maintainer privately. The maintainer reproduced the certificate and signed the entry; the code is not published. The signature must verify against a key in `hall_of_fame/maintainer_keys.json`.

C.name: self-reported
C.meaning: Only the author's certificate. It is never reproduced by anyone else, never ranked and never gets a medal; it is listed separately.

dedupe: Two entries with the same data hash and signal hash, or the same data hash and strategy source hash, are the same strategy under different names: only the earliest entry (by submission date, then id) stays ranked.
honesty: The score is evidence, not return: the order is ARL, depth, then the Deflated Sharpe, then the certificate date. A REJECT verdict is never ranked.
n_trials is mandatory: a certificate without it is refused, and its Deflated Sharpe already pays for every variant the author tried.
Only tier A (open) and tier B (privately verified and signed by the maintainer) entries are ranked. Self-reported (tier C) entries are shown apart and never get a medal.
Every entry carries the SHA-256 of its certificate; a changed certificate, a bad certificate signature or a bad maintainer signature fails the build.
The same strategy under another name is one entry (same data and signal hashes), and an author can add at most 3 entries per month.
Medals and holding periods come from monthly snapshots in hall_of_fame/history.jsonl, never from a hand edit.
A change of these rules or of the ARL rules is a new version and a new table; the old table is archived, never rewritten.
These tables rate the evidence about a strategy. They are not investment advice, not a recommendation to trade and say nothing about future returns.
